text:
maria: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/5273? Adds phoenix-7b model config, quant/profile, and a small tokenizer tweak to support 4k contexts. Hoping to merge before EOD if no blockers. TL;DR in the PR description.
aj: can you paste the specific config changes here? curious about perf and any backwards-incompatible bits. :eyes:
maria: sure — high level: sequence_length bumped to 4096, quant_profile set to int8_dynamic for faster fp32->int8 path, KV cache tweaks to avoid reallocation. No API surface changes. Perf estimate: ~10-15% latency overhead at 4k vs 2k but cost per token down due to int8. snippet:```diff
diff --git a/models/phoenix-7b/config.yaml b/models/phoenix-7b/config.yaml
@@ -12,6 +12,10 @@ model:
-  sequence_length: 2048
+  sequence_length: 4096
+  quant_profile: int8_dynamic
+  kv_cache_reserve: 0.15
+  optimize_attention: true
```
matt: skimmed the PR — left two small comments (nits + a test coverage ask). Also noticed tokenizer mapping change — @rachel can you sanity-check the tokenizer compatibility?
rachel: looking now. quick Q: does the tokenizer change remap any existing token ids used by embeddings? if so we need a migration plan or compatibility map.
maria: good call — it only adds a new special token `<IMAGE_EMBED>` and remaps two retired tokens to unused slots. I added a compatibility map in tokenizer_lookup to keep embedding indexes stable. example snippet in the PR:```yaml
compatibility_map:
  retired_42: unused_99942
  retired_43: unused_99943
```
aj: thanks. i'll review in ~30m and do a quick perf sanity run against the 4k suite. :thumbsup:
matt: quick note — please add a small unit test for the compatibility_map behavior (assert old token id returns mapped id). then i'm happy.
rachel: ok after that test and CI passing I can approve. request: add a one-line note in RELEASE_NOTES.md about the new token and that embedding indices are preserved.
deploy-bot: CI checks: build • tests • lint — all green :white_check_mark: (run id: 2026-06-12_17-02)
maria: added the unit test + release note per comments and pushed a fixup. thanks for the quick reviews. anyone else for final LGTM? we aim to merge by EOD and include in next canary rollout.
aj: LGTM :shipit:
matt: LGTM
rachel: LGTM — approving once CI finishes but looks good to me.
maria: merging in 10min unless anyone objects. thanks team! :tada:
